comment: THE DEAD-CODE FENCE baseline. THE FENCE IS AT ZERO: every source file is reachable from a live root. This list must stay empty. Root cause: a slice ships module+test, a test IS a caller, so nothing ever checked reachability from a live root and the suite certified dead code as healthy. This is a RATCHET: maxUnreachable may only ever be LOWERED and files may only ever be REMOVED from this list (by wiring them to a live root or deleting them). NEVER add a file here to make a failing build pass — wire it or delete it. A module is not done when its test passes; it is done when a human can reach it.
